title: Lumen City switches on its first neighbourhood solar microgrid
snippet: The pilot in Harbor District links 1,200 rooftop panels and a 4 MWh battery; the city says it can keep 3,000 homes powered for six hours during an outage.

title: 流明市港區社區微電網啟用 市府：停電時可供電六小時
snippet: 流明市政府表示，港區微電網串連 1,200 組屋頂太陽能板與 4 MWh 儲能電池，停電時可維持約 3,000 戶供電六小時；總經費新台幣 4.2 億元。

title: What a neighbourhood microgrid really costs
snippet: An independent review puts Lumen City's microgrid at NT$4.6 billion over ten years once maintenance is counted, and warns battery capacity fades about 2% a year.

title: Harbor District residents on living next to the battery park
snippet: Residents welcome fewer outages but ask about fire safety at the battery site; the fire department inspected it in August.

title: Coffee bean prices hit a three-year high
snippet: Wholesale arabica prices rose 18% this quarter after a poor harvest.
